answer: Each identity registers one jade claim on the public shale ledger at a self-assessed value and pays 5% of that value per epoch in copper. Anyone may buy at the assessed value, so a lowball ring loses its slots and overpricing bleeds tax; an auditor rechecks every assessment on the ledger. A thousand fakes tie up 100,000 credits and bleed 5,000 per epoch against a 40,000 pool, while one honest claim costs 5 per epoch.
